Q03.answer:
(a) **0%.** After 100% Physical-to-Lightning conversion, the damage scales as Lightning. Global increased Physical Damage on the passive tree gives it no bonus.

(b) **Multiplicative.** At +20% Quality, a Martial Weapon’s physical damage is **1.20×** its value at 0% Quality, including local increased Physical Damage.

(c) **+100% Critical Hit Damage Bonus**, for a total base crit multiplier of **200% (2×)**.

Q04.answer:
(a) **Yes.** Different skills can each use a copy of the same standard Support Gem. A single skill can use only **1 copy** of that support.

(b) **No.** Rakiata’s Flow is a drop-only Lineage Support and cannot be engraved from an Uncut Support Gem. You can equip **1 copy per character**.

(c) **No.** Grim Feast no longer grants Energy Shield overflow.

Q01.answer:
(a) **Non-poison Chaos hits do not bypass Energy Shield (ES).** Each 1 point of Chaos hit damage after mitigation removes 2 ES. Any damage the shield cannot absorb reaches Life.

(b) **Both Bleeding and Poison bypass ES.** Their damage over time goes directly to Life.

(c) **No.** A hit must deal damage to Life to inflict Bleeding. If ES absorbs the whole hit, it cannot inflict Bleeding. If the hit takes the CI character’s only Life point, the hit itself kills them.

Q06.answer:
(a) **No.** `Expert Hexer's Robe` is not a live endgame Body Armour base in 0.5.5.

(b) **No.** You can overwrite a socketed Rune or Soul Core with another compatible Rune or Soul Core. Doing so destroys the original. You cannot remove it intact for reuse.

(c) A **Talisman** is a two-handed melee weapon used for shapeshifting. It occupies both weapon hands.

Q02.answer:
(a) **75%** is the base maximum passive Block chance.

(b) **Glancing Blows** doubles passive Block chance, subject to the same cap. A blocked hit still deals **50%** of its damage.

(c) **Deflection** is the Dexterity defence. A successful deflection prevents **40%** of a hit’s damage and can apply to attacks and spells alike. My recollection is that the chance caps at **95%**, but I’m uncertain of that cap for patch 0.5.5.

Q05.answer:

Q09.answer:
The exact odds require the patch 0.5.5 Warmonger Bow mod weights. The target weight of 25 and the two level cutoffs alone do not determine either pool total.

| Orb | Eligible pool weight at ilvl 82 | Hit probability | Expected independent attempts |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Greater Exalted | \(W_G=\sum_{35\le L\le82}w\) | \((2500/W_G)\%\) | \(W_G/25\) |
| Perfect Exalted | \(W_P=\sum_{50\le L\le82}w\) | \((2500/W_P)\%\) | \(W_P/25\) |

Here \(L\) is each eligible mod’s level and \(w\) is its spawn weight on the bow. **Perfect has better odds** by a factor of \(W_G/W_P\): it removes the weight of mod levels 35–49 while retaining the T1 target’s full weight of 25.

Q08.answer:
**(a)** None of the three are available to use in a live Forbidden Rites league. PoE2 has no Orb of Scouring, and both Omen of Homogenising Exaltation and Recombinators are unavailable in that league.

**(b)** Lesser, Normal, and Greater Essences upgrade a **Magic** item to **Rare**, preserving its existing modifiers and adding the essence’s guaranteed modifier. A **Perfect Essence** works on an existing **Rare** item. It removes one random modifier and adds its guaranteed modifier.

**(c)** A Fracturing Orb requires a **Rare item with at least 4 explicit modifiers** and fractures one at random. Omen of Whittling forces a Chaos Orb to remove the modifier with the **lowest modifier level** (the minimum item level required for that modifier’s tier). Ties are broken randomly.

Q11.answer:

**(b)** The default Honour Resistance cap is **75%**. At **+100% effective quantity of relics dropped by monsters**, Zarokh drops **two Unique Relics**. You can reach that threshold with **+77%** from relics and the boon granting **30% increased relic effect**.

Q02.answer:
**(a)** Passive Block chance caps at **50%** without modifiers to maximum Block chance.

**(b)** Glancing Blows makes Chance to Evade **Unlucky** and Chance to Deflect **Lucky**. Each rolls twice. Evading requires both rolls to succeed, while deflecting requires only one.

**(c)** **Deflection Rating** replaced Spell Suppression on Dexterity gear. A successful Deflect prevents **40%** of an attack or spell hit’s damage by default. The **chance to Deflect caps at 95%** per roll.

Q01.answer:
**(a) No.** A non-poison Chaos hit damages Energy Shield first. Each point of Chaos damage after mitigation removes **2 ES** while Energy Shield remains.

**(b) Yes.** Both Bleeding and Poison bypass Energy Shield and deal their damage over time directly to Life.

**(c) No.** Chaos Inoculation sets maximum Life to 1 and explicitly grants immunity to both **Chaos damage and Bleeding**. Bleeding therefore cannot kill a CI character.

Q03.answer:
**(a) 0%.** With 100% conversion to Lightning, global “increased Physical Damage” on the passive tree contributes nothing to the converted damage. It now scales with Lightning damage modifiers.
